english.title: Resist / wilfully obstruct a National Crime Agency officer designated as an immigration officer / person assisting
english.standardoffencewording:

english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 21(1) and (2) of Schedule 5 to of the Crime and Courts Act 2013.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Designated officer means the Director General or any other National Crime Agency officer if designated as having operational powers

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 51 weeks imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level 3 on the standard scale.

Note:
Until the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 (alteration of penalties for summary offences) the reference to the period of 51 weeks is to be read as a reference to the period of 1 month.

Time limit on prosecutions:
Six months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level three on the legislative standard scale
